services.desc: Since the Museum opened in 1996, we have established programs within our community that help foster and develop our youth for the workforce and entrepreneurship. In January 2021, we started the Sojourner Truth African Heritage Museum Youth Docent Program. We have seven paid youth ranging from middle school to second-year college that are researching, discussing, and engaging visitors in all of our exhibitions. blurb: Shonna McDaniels, a visual artist and community activist, envisioned an institution to preserve Black history and celebrate the accomplishments of African American people and their legacy. As a result the previous name of Sojourner Truth Multicultural Art Museum changed to Sojourner Truth African American Museum.
